name: Agent Apps
author: vladkarok
description: Installed and newest vendor version of the Claude Desktop, Codex and ZCode apps in the Omarchy bar, with a one-click update from the vendor .deb.

barWidget.description: Compares each installed AI agent desktop app against its vendor's release feed and builds the new version in a terminal when you press Update.

schema.label: Notify on new versions
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when a vendor publishes a version newer than the installed one.
